SUMMARY: hairstyle twin high loop buns with long spiral tails and an airy center fringe; costume silhouette several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt — plates, not cloth — with the legs showing between them; design idea Eight articulated hip plates rotate around a compact central coupling, a trigram-inspired mechanical armor joint.; face a soft, gentle warmth, light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone, diamond-shaped face with softly defined cheekbones and a tapered chin, softly deep-set eyes of natural size, ember-orange eyes, soft feathered brows, slim, delicate nose with a refined bridge, thin lips with a defined cupid's bow; expression firm resolve.

A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Zhuge Shang of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the grandchild of Zhuge Liang who charged into the Wei lines at Mianzhu.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a youthful face.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a soft, gentle warmth; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; diamond-shaped face with softly defined cheekbones and a tapered chin; softly deep-set eyes of natural size; ember-orange eyes; soft feathered brows; slim, delicate nose with a refined bridge; thin lips with a defined cupid's bow.
Body and hair: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist build; twin high loop buns with long spiral tails and an airy center fringe; bright amethyst-purple hair.
Expression: a firm, resolute look with calm, steady eyes, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: fearless resolve, Shu armor with her grandmother's trigram crest, a dawn-red sash.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as an assault-type mecha frame — heavy armor plates, thruster packs, reinforced limbs, her weapon rebuilt as a large mecha armament. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt — plates, not cloth — with the legs showing between them. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Design idea: Eight articulated hip plates rotate around a compact central coupling, a trigram-inspired mechanical armor joint.
Colours: jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade. Faction frame: jade-green and white plating with imperial-gold trims, organic layered armor like overlapping leaves, a resilient all-terrain frame, warm green glow lines.
Signature item: a slim charging spear, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates, and bare upper thighs between the hip armor and thigh-high leg plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Shu frontier colony on a jade-green moon: terraced garden cities under vast glass domes, a ringed gas giant filling the sky, an orbital elevator climbing into space, starship docks glowing green.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
